title: tidy_apply
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.13) — shape from tidy-prd.md §7 tidy_apply, FR-12, FR-16, FR-17, FR-18, §8; not routed yet. CEP WNC_TIDY.apply (signed bridge). Apply a previewed plan. The host re-checks usage live and refuses to remove a used item or a non-backup sequence even if asked (FR-16). Order (FR-17): moves -> removals (into one temporary bin, then that bin is deleted) -> empty bins by nodeId, only when children.numItems === 0, index rebuilt after each delete -> colours -> nest renames; each step fail-safe, failures go to problems. Safety (verbatim, §8): remove from the project only, media files are only ever read; never remove a used item or a non-backup sequence; never delete a bin that holds anything, find bins by nodeId; save + backup copy before applying (tidy_save, then the engine copies the .prproj).
